description: Grounded-generation guard checks using real passages from controlled Approved Documents A, C, K and 7.

cases.claim_text: The recommended minimum foundation widths in Table 10 may be used.
cases.evidence_quote: The recommended minimum widths of foundations given in Table 10 may be used.

cases.claim_text: Where ground contaminants are present, subsoil drainage should be considered to limit transportation of water-borne contaminants.
cases.evidence_quote: Where contaminants are present in the ground, consideration should be given to subsoil drainage to prevent the transportation of water- borne contaminants to the foundations or into the building or its services.

cases.claim_text: For ramp goings between 2m and 10m, gradients may be interpolated, including 1:14 for 4m or 1:19 for 9m.
cases.evidence_quote: For goings between 2m and 10m, it is acceptable to interpolate between the maximum gradients i.e. 1:14 for 4m going or 1:19 for 9m going

cases.claim_text: The person carrying out the work should show that workmanship provides the appropriate protection and performance.
cases.evidence_quote: The person carrying out the work should show that the workmanship will provide the appropriate level of protection and performance.
